title: Positive-degree induction step for inverse-image Čech comparison
statement: Let g : Y → X be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], U,V open covers with every nonempty V-tuple intersection contained in the preimage of its U-tuple intersection, and c,c′ normalized comparison systems [def-pc-cech-comparison-system]. Let T be any short exact sequence of abelian sheaves on X whose quotient map is surjective on U-tuple sections and whose exact inverse-image quotient map [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison] is surjective on V-tuple sections. For q ≥ 0 and y in degree-q Čech cohomology of T.X₃, suppose the unit cochain map [def-pc-cech-inverse-image-cochain-map] commutes with the comparisons on y. Then it commutes with the comparisons in degree q+1 on cechδ(T)(y). No surjectivity of the connecting maps is assumed.

source.place: Lemma 20.15.1 and Tag 01EQ, compatibility of comparison maps; elementary connecting-map consequence for normalized systems

proof.text: Use naturality of the adjunction-unit cochain map and HomologySequence.δ_naturality to commute the two Čech connecting maps.

Apply the connecting laws for each normalized comparison system, then exact inverse-image functoriality of Ext and associativity to rewrite the sheaf connecting map; substitute the degree-q hypothesis.

proof_origin.place: Elementary connecting-map diagram chase in the relative-effacement induction, written by Q3

theorem cechComparison_inverseImage_succ_step
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : ι → Y.Opens) (hcover : iSup U = ⊤)
    (hcover' : iSup V = ⊤)
    (hinter : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι),
      (⨅ l, V (y l)) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (⨅ l, U (y l)))
    (c : CechComparisonSystem U hcover) (c' : CechComparisonSystem V hcover')
    (T : ShortComplex (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
    (hT : T.ShortExact)
    (hg : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι),
      Function.Surjective (T.g.hom.app (op (⨅ l, U (y l)))))
    (hg' : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι),
      Function.Surjective (((invImage g).map T.g).hom.app (op (⨅ l, V (y l)))))
    (q : ℕ) (y : (TopCat.Sheaf.cechCohomologyFunctor U q).obj T.X₃)
    (hih : (c'.comparison q).app ((invImage g).obj T.X₃)
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (cechInverseImageCochainMap g U V hinter T.X₃ ((invImage g).obj T.X₃)
            ((TopCat.Sheaf.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u} g.base).unit.app
              T.X₃).hom) q y) =
      Sheaf.H.mapFunctor (invImage g) (constIso g).symm T.X₃ q
        ((c.comparison q).app T.X₃ y)) :
    (c'.comparison (q + 1)).app ((invImage g).obj T.X₁)
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (cechInverseImageCochainMap g U V hinter T.X₁ ((invImage g).obj T.X₁)
            ((TopCat.Sheaf.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u} g.base).unit.app
              T.X₁).hom) (q + 1)
          (TopCat.Sheaf.cechδ U hT hg q y)) =
      Sheaf.H.mapFunctor (invImage g) (constIso g).symm T.X₁ (q + 1)
        ((c.comparison (q + 1)).app T.X₁
          (TopCat.Sheaf.cechδ U hT hg q y))
